pages.text: Make a flask for storage, transfers, and building a distillery. Ferment in the open mash tub.

pages.title: Watch the Stage
pages.text: The open mash tub ferments a brew through two stages. Durations depend on the brew, and the process meter shows the current countdown. Pour it out for drinking or move it to a barrel or distillery.

pages.title: Avoid Sour Batches
pages.text: Fully fermented liquid left in an open tub eventually acetifies to vinegar. Decant promptly after the desired stage. Use a flask for storage or a barrel for controlled aging.
